items.title: Darboe Rallies Support in Allunhari, URR; Urges Unity Ahead of December Presidential Election
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe Ousainu Darboe, leader of the United Democratic Party, thanked supporters in the Upper River Region on Saturday after thousands gathered in Allunhari for a rally organized by the UDP-led alliance and its partners in the Gambia First Coalition ahead of the Dec. 5 ...
items.author: Seedy Jobe
